locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Estimation based on average data from European producers, collecte from FEFCO

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Average of present used technology

# Included processes
This module includes the production of boxes out of corrugated board. It contains the steps of cutting, folding and printing. Besides the input of corrugated board, inks and glues are considered as well as the electricity consumption.
